name: Qwen 2.5 72B Instruct
description: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct is the flagship 72.7-billion parameter instruction-tuned language model in Alibaba's Qwen2.5 series. Pre-trained on 18 trillion tokens, it delivers massive improvements in instruction following, coding, mathematical reasoning, multilingual understanding, and structured data generation.
keyFeatures: Massive Pre-training Scale: 72.7 billion parameters trained on 18 trillion high-quality tokens
Long Context Support: Native support for input contexts up to 131,072 (128K) tokens and generation up to 8,192 tokens
Multilingual Versatility: Full comprehension and response capabilities across 29+ languages
Frontier Code & Math Reasoning: SOTA open-weights performance on competitive coding, math, Program-of-Thought, and tool-integrated reasoning
Structured Data & Instruction Alignment: Specialized fine-tuning for structured output generation (JSON, tables) and strict system instruction adherence
curatorNotes: Verified paper arXiv:2412.15115 and open-weights release from Alibaba Qwen Team.
